meta.game: Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5 / Xbox Series X|S), story mode, released 2026-11-19
meta.method: 40 web searches. Everything below is compiled from search-result summaries only; no source page was opened, so wording, dates and details were not checked against the pages themselves.
meta.status_rule: working = reported working after 01.002.002, or not mentioned in any patch notes (see status_basis for which); patched = fixed in a named update; unclear = mixed or conflicting reports, or only a headline is known.

status_basis_values.post_patch_reports: outlets or players report it still present after 01.002.002
status_basis_values.not_in_patch_notes: no post-patch test found; the 01.002.002 notes simply do not mention it
status_basis_values.mixed_reports: sources disagree on whether it works at all
status_basis_values.patch_notes: listed as fixed in Rockstar's notes as relayed by outlets
status_basis_values.headline_only: only a video title or one-line mention was found

meta.verified_rule: items[]: true only if at least two independent sources describe the same glitch at the same place. unplaced[]: true if at least two independent sources describe the same mechanism (there is no fixed place to match).
meta.extra_fields: Beyond the requested shape, each entry also carries status_basis, version, patched_in and notes. unplaced[] holds glitches with no fixed map location (or whose location was not found); it uses the same fields.
coverage_gaps: No place-tied out-of-bounds, wall-breach, police safe-spot, infinite ammo/health, physics-launch or broken-interior spot was found in any search. The only out-of-bounds technique found (phone clip) works anywhere there is a tight gap.
No story-mode vehicle, weapon or item duplication glitch was found in written sources; only YouTube video titles claim one.
No respawning-safe, cash-register or ATM exploit other than the Apollo Aggregates warehouse was found.

patches.notes: Pre-launch update. No official patch notes were published, so what it changed is unknown.
Pre-launch update. No official patch notes were published, so what it changed is unknown.

First post-launch title update, fixes only. Seven fixes as relayed by outlets from Rockstar Support: (1) several crash causes; (2) weather that stopped changing for long stretches; (3) autosaves not being recorded; (4) story phone calls that failed to trigger; (5) players unable to lose their Wanted Level; (6) gym deadlift bar could not be used; (7) partner characters not handing over bags to sell to fences. Reported size about 603.8 MB on PS5 and about 1.6 GB on Xbox Series X|S (not official figures); PS5 rollout in waves. NOT mentioned in the notes: the Apollo Aggregates money glitch, the Chapter 3 Jason softlock, the Xbox frame-rate trick, falling through the map. Conflicts between outlets: one says the gym and autosave fixes are still unconfirmed in play; one search summary of MP1st says the changelog lists players falling through the map or terrain, which no other outlet's seven-fix list includes.

items.name: Apollo Aggregates ('Red Barn') loot respawn - save and reload
items.area: East / northeast of Hamlet, north of Key Lento, south of Route 35
items.landmark: Apollo Aggregates - red warehouse ('red barn') in a gravel yard; three large rectangular pools beside the highway
items.spot: Long red building just southeast of the three pools, at the bend in the access road. Drive through the gravel yard past the barrier and excavators; the way in is the grey door beside the Apollo trailer. Loot inside: cocaine in two teddy-bear vans, on tables in a back room and in a safe, plus cash.
items.steps: Bring Jason's personal vehicle (not a stolen car), fill stash bags with the cocaine and cash and store them in the trunk (about four bags). Make a manual save and load it: the warehouse loot is back while the bags stay in the car. Sell the bags (guides name Brian's Lockup in southwest Key Lento, keypad code 7700) and repeat.
items.gives: Repeatable cash: about $8,000-11,000 per run reported (higher claims of $12,000-15,000; PC Gamer reports about $50,000 in 15 minutes).
items.desc_ru: Денежный глитч на складе Apollo Aggregates («красный амбар») к востоку от Хэмлета, севернее Ки-Ленто. Соберите кокаин и наличку в сумки, сложите их в багажник личной машины Джейсона, сделайте ручное сохранение и загрузите его — добыча на складе появится снова, а сумки останутся в машине (примерно $8–11 тыс. за заход). По сообщениям игроков, работает после патча 01.002.002 от 23.11.2026, но Rockstar может исправить его в любой момент.
items.notes: Location naming differs between sources and is assumed, not proven, to be one site: 'abandoned red barn northeast of Hamlet' (Notebookcheck and news outlets), 'Apollo Aggregates warehouse east of Hamlet in South Vice-Dale County' (guides), 'Hamlet industrial area, north of Key Lento' (PC Gamer), 'Dale County' (MMOExp). One map database (gta6carte.com) files Apollo Aggregates under Peregrine Bay with its own map coordinates x -1837, y -2876. Post-patch status rests on player reports relayed by outlets, not on a Rockstar statement; Comicbook notes it is not established that those players had fully closed and relaunched the game on the new version. Respawn is inconsistent: the centre cash bag, first-room cocaine and counting-machine money may not come back, and one guide says the safe respawns only once per in-game day while the van cocaine respawns every time. Guides say money held at the end of Chapter 1 is lost, so farm from Chapter 2; Kotaku adds that story progress can cut off access to your money. Payment from Brian's Lockup arrives later via Jason's mailbox, and some players report it not arriving.

items.name: Apollo Aggregates loot respawn - character-switch variant
items.area: East of Hamlet, north of Key Lento
items.spot: Same warehouse as the save-and-reload method (same map marker).
items.steps: Loot the warehouse as Lucia, switch to Jason, then switch straight back to Lucia; the cocaine is back within seconds. Jason has to be far enough away from the warehouse for the reset to work.
items.gives: The same loot again without reloading a save.
items.desc_ru: Вариант глитча на складе Apollo Aggregates к востоку от Хэмлета: обчистите склад за Лусию, переключитесь на Джейсона и сразу обратно — кокаин появляется снова за несколько секунд (Джейсон должен быть достаточно далеко от склада). Описан одним источником, после патча 01.002.002 отдельно не проверялся; может быть исправлен позже.
items.notes: Single source (Vice). No post-patch test of this specific variant was found; the patch notes do not mention the warehouse at all.

items.name: Apollo Aggregates loot respawn - van drive-away variant (Chapter 2)
items.area: East of Hamlet, north of Key Lento
items.spot: Same warehouse as the save-and-reload method (same map marker); uses the van there.
items.steps: In Chapter 2, get in the van and drive away from the warehouse for about 30-40 seconds, then turn around and drive back; the loot is reported to have respawned. Do not store the van at your house before selling - the product disappears.
items.gives: Claimed about $500,000 per hour; one guide gives about $7,200 per bag and a van with 10 storage slots.
items.desc_ru: Вариант глитча на складе Apollo Aggregates (глава 2): сядьте в фургон, отъедьте от склада на 30–40 секунд и вернитесь — добыча, по сообщениям, появляется снова без перезагрузки. Не ставьте фургон у дома до продажи — товар исчезнет. Способ подтверждён слабо и может быть исправлен позже.
items.notes: Two guide sites describe it, but MMOExp says it comes from one creator's reported results, so the sources are probably not independent; MMOExp places it in 'Dale County'. A YouTube title claims a $500,000 method still works 'after update', but only the title is known.

items.name: Store robbery reset (rob the same stores again without cooldown)
items.landmark: Stores near Jason's house; one guide names the Inked Mermaid tattoo studio
items.steps: Rob the nearby stores (they then show as closed on the map). Start a story mission that opens with a cutscene, choose Restart Mission as it begins, then pause and choose Quit Mission; the stores reportedly show as open again. One guide says to skip the weapon shop because it raises the Wanted Level too high.
items.gives: Repeat store robberies without waiting for the normal cooldown.
items.desc_ru: Сброс ограбленных магазинов возле дома Джейсона (в одном гайде назван тату-салон Inked Mermaid): ограбьте магазины, запустите сюжетную миссию с катсценой, выберите «Перезапустить миссию», затем «Выйти из миссии» — магазины якобы снова открыты. Сообщения противоречивы, у части игроков не срабатывает; может быть исправлено позже.
items.notes: Mechanism is described by two or three guide sites, but the place is not pinned to a named district (nothing in the results says which town Jason's house or the Inked Mermaid is in), reports are mixed, and one player reported it not working on 2026-11-20. No post-patch test found.

items.name: Chapter 3 'Missing Persons' softlock - Jason greyed out
items.landmark: Missing Persons case / mission in Kelly County
items.steps: Finishing the Kelly County Missing Persons case early in Chapter 3 leaves Jason greyed out on the character wheel: no switching, he does not answer calls and Lucia gets no story mission. Avoid it by doing the case in Chapter 2 or making a manual save before starting; a player-reported workaround is calling Jason from Lucia's phone to hang out.
items.gives: Nothing - it is a progression lock (a hazard to warn about, not an exploit).
items.desc_ru: Опасный баг: если пройти дело «Missing Persons» в округе Келли в начале 3-й главы, Джейсон остаётся недоступным (серый на колесе персонажей) и сюжет не продвигается. Проходите дело во 2-й главе или сделайте перед ним ручное сохранение. Патч 01.002.002 баг не исправил; возможно, его починят позже.
items.notes: Bug, not an exploit; included because it is tied to a mission location. Exact start point within Kelly County was not given in the results. Rockstar has not acknowledged it.

items.name: Donnie's payment does not appear at the trailer
items.landmark: Donnie's trailer; mailbox outside Jason's house
items.steps: Donnie's payment does not show up at the trailer. Sleep so about a day passes, wait for his text, then take the cash from the mailbox outside Jason's house.
items.gives: Nothing extra - a workaround to collect a payment that looks missing.
items.desc_ru: Баг с оплатой от Донни: деньги не появляются у трейлера. Поспите около суток, дождитесь его сообщения и заберите наличные из почтового ящика у дома Джейсона. Возможно, это задуманная задержка, а не баг; поведение может измениться после патчей.
items.notes: May be an intended delayed payment rather than a bug. One guide warns that if you start the mission 'Swamped' before the money arrives, it is gone. Region of the trailer and house was not stated in the results.

items.name: Gym deadlift bar could not be used
items.landmark: Gym (deadlift bar); the specific gym is not named in the sources
items.steps: The deadlift bar in the gym could not be interacted with.
items.desc_ru: Баг в спортзале: штангу для становой тяги нельзя было использовать. Исправлено в патче 01.002.002 от 23.11.2026.
items.notes: Patched; listed so it can be excluded. One outlet said it was still unconfirmed whether the gym fix works in play.

unplaced.name: Phone clip - fall under the map / pass through walls
unplaced.spot: No fixed place: any tight gap, e.g. between a parked car and a fence or wall, or a tight corner.
unplaced.steps: Squeeze Jason into a tight gap between a parked car and a fence (or crouch into a tight corner, or park a car at an angle to narrow the gap), then take out the in-game phone. The character clips into the wall or drops through the map; there is no way back up, so save first and reload.
unplaced.gives: Under-the-map / inside-wall access. Nothing in the results says it gets you into locked interiors.
unplaced.desc_ru: Провал под карту через телефон: зажмите Джейсона в узком зазоре между припаркованной машиной и забором или стеной и достаньте телефон — персонаж проваливается сквозь стену или под карту. Работает в любом подходящем месте, вернуться нельзя, поэтому сначала сохранитесь. После патча 01.002.002 не перепроверялся; может быть исправлен.
unplaced.notes: All reports are from launch week, before 01.002.002. The seven-fix list relayed by most outlets does not cover it, but one search summary of MP1st says the changelog mentions falling through the map or terrain, so post-patch status is genuinely unknown. A YouTube video titled 'GTA 6 Wall Breach Glitch - How to Get Under the Map!' exists; its location and steps are unknown.

unplaced.name: Prologue: Lucia falls through the map
unplaced.landmark: Prologue / first mission (location not named in the sources)
unplaced.steps: Random bug during the prologue: Lucia drops through the floor or road and falls under the world. Clips place it near the locker, in her flashback sequence, or when she is tased on a scooter during the police arrest; the game then puts her back.
unplaced.gives: Nothing - an unintended fall, not a repeatable exploit.
unplaced.desc_ru: Баг пролога: Лусия может провалиться сквозь пол или дорогу и упасть под карту (у шкафчика, во флешбэке или при аресте на скутере). Это случайная ошибка, а не воспроизводимый эксплойт; может быть исправлена патчем.
unplaced.notes: Mission-bound and not reproducible on demand. Trigger details differ between trackers.

unplaced.name: Car launched into the air after hitting vegetation
unplaced.spot: No confirmed tree or bush reproduces it consistently.
unplaced.steps: Collisions between cars and plants can throw the vehicle upward, similar to GTA IV's swing-set bug. No reliable spot or method is documented.
unplaced.desc_ru: Физический баг: при столкновении с растительностью машину может подбросить в воздух, как в баге с качелями из GTA IV. Конкретного воспроизводимого места пока не найдено; может быть исправлено.
unplaced.notes: The vegetation link appears in one tracker only; viral clips of flying cars are reported by several outlets without a location.

unplaced.name: Xbox frame-rate unlock via 60 Hz display setting / app switch
unplaced.spot: Console setting, not a map location.
unplaced.steps: Set the Xbox display to 60 Hz and start GTA 6. Without quitting, start another game from the Guide, then switch back to GTA 6.
unplaced.gives: Unofficial unlocked frame rate (one list says up to 90 FPS); display-setting changes are also reported to cause double-speed movement.
unplaced.desc_ru: Трюк на Xbox: поставьте в настройках консоли 60 Гц, запустите GTA 6, не выходя из игры откройте другую игру через Guide и вернитесь — частота кадров разблокируется. Не привязан к месту на карте; может быть закрыт патчем.
unplaced.notes: A search summary states that one outlet noted 01.002.002 did not address the Xbox 60 FPS glitch, but the summary did not identify which page said so.

unplaced.name: Loot bag overfill ($4,000 in a $3,200 bag)
unplaced.steps: Stop filling the bag at $2,800 and crack the safe last; the bag that normally caps at $3,200 reportedly ends up holding $4,000.
unplaced.desc_ru: Трюк с сумкой: остановитесь на $2 800 и вскрывайте сейф последним — в сумку с лимитом $3 200 якобы помещается $4 000. Не подтверждено, к месту не привязано; может быть исправлено.
unplaced.notes: Single source, which itself marks it as unconfirmed.

unplaced.name: Car dupe / duplication money glitch claimed in YouTube titles
unplaced.desc_ru: На YouTube есть ролики с заголовками о дюпе машин и денег в GTA 6 «после патча», но способ и место неизвестны и ничем не подтверждены. Не добавлять на карту без проверки.
unplaced.notes: Only the video titles are known ('NEW CAR DUPE / UNLIMITED MONEY GLITCH IN GTA 6 AFTER PATCH!', 'NEW DUPLICATION GLITCH / UNLIMITED MONEY IN GTA 6! CHAPTER 2', 'EASY 500K MONEY DUPLICATION IN CHAPTER 2'). No written source describes any vehicle, weapon or item duplication in story mode; these may simply be the Apollo Aggregates loop under a different label.

unplaced.name: Lucia wardrobe glitch (top missing after body armour breaks)
unplaced.steps: Uses the outfit and body-armour systems: when Lucia's body armour is destroyed, the top underneath does not come back.
unplaced.desc_ru: Косметический глитч с одеждой Лусии: после разрушения бронежилета верх одежды не возвращается. К месту на карте не привязан; может быть исправлен.
unplaced.notes: Single source. Probably not wanted on a map; listed for completeness.

unplaced.name: First-person camera lock
unplaced.steps: Reported trigger: remap the Camera button and rapidly exit the in-game phone while inside a vehicle. The camera then stays in first person on foot, driving and aiming.
unplaced.desc_ru: Глитч камеры: после переназначения кнопки камеры и быстрого выхода из телефона в машине вид от первого лица фиксируется пешком, за рулём и при прицеливании. К месту не привязан; может быть исправлен.
unplaced.notes: The effect is from meowdb; the trigger steps come from a search summary of bug trackers that did not identify the exact page.
